# Ringfence

> A control layer between AI agents and Airwallex payouts: the agent proposes, code checks, a person signs. Payroll is the first use. Airwallex sandbox and Metal testnet only: no real money moves.

## Use it

- [MCP server](docs/MCP.md): connect any MCP client that supports HTTP with `claude mcp add --transport http ringfence https://ringfence-hs23-eu.indiasouthcentral.cloudapp.azure.com/mcp`. Tools: run_payroll, release_payroll, payroll_status, payroll_proof. There is no approve tool: a person approves on a passkey page.
- [Run it](docs/RUN_IT.md): offline demo with `make fake-demo`, no keys needed.
- [Read-only HTTP API](docs/API.md)

## Understand it

- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)
- [Threat model](docs/THREAT_MODEL.md)
- [Decisions](docs/DECISIONS.md)
- [Security findings](FINDINGS.md): five ways an agent built from Airwallex's own guidance paid the wrong account or paid twice
- [A recorded live run](docs/PROOF.md): every Airwallex ID

## What is simulated

Payouts reaching PAID, a short employer's deposit and the platform's fee credit use Airwallex sandbox simulation endpoints and are labelled [SIMULATED]. Transfers, FX, beneficiaries and the isolation check are real sandbox calls.

## Limits

Sandbox only. The public MCP endpoint has no login. See [limitations](README.md#limitations-and-path-to-production).
